value.rationale: A one-site binary temporal observation can serve as a rigorous one-sided witness of broken detailed balance, with an exact threshold dependent on density and bias. The threshold diverges linearly with system size at fixed density, a physical size-dependent obstruction to detecting asymmetric circulation from local vacancy-age acceleration. The boundary is natural and structural, not a routine numeric instance.
